abstract: Maintains vehicle telemetry integrations and certified ambient payload specifications
system_message:
You are Fleet engineering director (FED). As the Fleet engineering director (FED), you maintain records on vehicle telemetry integrations and certified ambient payload specifications, as well as depot fleet charging infrastructure.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Depot fleet charging（CHARG）
information_points.content:
FED-CHARG-Y34：AeroMed Global Coldchain operates 12 operational high-voltage DC fast-charging ports across its regional consolidation hub facilities.
FED-CHARG-ZWG：Polaris CryoLogistics Alliance provides 18 operational high-voltage DC fast-charging ports across its regional consolidation hub facilities.
FED-CHARG-QXL：Vanguard BioLogistics Network maintains 24 operational high-voltage DC fast-charging ports across its regional consolidation hub facilities.

information_points.title: Maintains vehicle telemetry integrations and certified ambient payload specifications（FLTENG）
information_points.content:
FED-FLTENG-HUL：For AeroMed Global Coldchain, fleet telemetry integration is verified across the active vehicle fleet, and the certified ambient compartment payload is 500 kg per single dedicated delivery vehicle.
FED-FLTENG-O80：For Polaris CryoLogistics Alliance, fleet telemetry integration is not in place across the active vehicle fleet, while the certified ambient compartment payload is 500 kg per single dedicated delivery vehicle.
FED-FLTENG-HCA：For Vanguard BioLogistics Network, fleet telemetry integration is active across the vehicle fleet, and the certified ambient compartment payload is rated at 600 kg per single dedicated delivery vehicle.
